title: Compute sound velocities and Debye temperature
action: Read the provided CSV file (ferrites_elastic_data.csv). For each composition, extract the X-ray density (ρ) from the `xray_density` column, Young's modulus E, rigidity modulus μ, molar mass M, and atoms per formula unit n. Compute shear velocity V_s = sqrt(μ/ρ), Poisson's ratio σ = (E/(2μ)) - 1, longitudinal velocity V_l = sqrt(E(1-σ)/(ρ(1+σ)(1-2σ))), mean velocity V_m = [(1/3)(1/V_l³ + 2/V_s³)]^{-1/3}, and Debye temperature θ = (h/k_B)(3 n N_A ρ/(4π M))^{1/3} V_m with constants h = 6.62607015e-34 J·s, k_B = 1.380649e-23 J/K, N_A = 6.02214076e23 mol^{-1}. Write the results to a CSV file with columns: composition, V_l (m/s), V_s (m/s), V_m (m/s), theta (K).
description: CSV containing sound velocities and Debye temperature for each ferrite composition, computed using X-ray density and Anderson's method.
output_schema: Columns: composition (string), V_l (float, m/s), V_s (float, m/s), V_m (float, m/s), theta (float, K). One row per composition, same order as input.

title: Compute percentage changes in elastic moduli
action: Using the same input CSV, compute the percentage increase in Young's modulus (E) and rigidity modulus (μ) for (a) adding 0.25 mol Mg to Mn ferrite (comparing MnFe2O4 and Mn0.75Mg0.25Fe2O4) and (b) adding 0.1 mol Mn to Mg ferrite (comparing MgFe2O4 and Mn0.10Mg0.90Fe2O4). Write the results to a text file with four lines, each in the format: '<pair>: <percentage>%'.
description: Text file reporting the percentage increases in E and μ for the specified composition substitutions.
output_schema: Four lines: Mn→Mn0.75Mg0.25 E increase: <pct>%, Mn→Mn0.75Mg0.25 μ increase: <pct>%, Mg→Mn0.10Mg0.90 E increase: <pct>%, Mg→Mn0.10Mg0.90 μ increase: <pct>%. Percentages rounded to one decimal place.
